title: Large NSClient time display
symptom: The time display in NSClient is massive on the top right side, taking up space and preventing the BG value from being completely visible when there is a double digit BG value or if the font size of the phone is increased.
fix: A PR (#1436) scaled down the text size, but the thread does not confirm if it resolved the issue.
evidence_quote: I scaled down the text size in PR #1436 could you validate this works for you well for your device?
